name: H04 DEEP_ATX_HEADER: back to the counted loop #{7,}

name: H05 DEEP_ATX_HEADER: a blank is required before the hashes

name: H06 DEEP_ATX_HEADER: only a space may follow the run

name: H09 DEEP_ATX_HEADER: the tail stops at the line end only for LF
